newsitem.title: USA: TransTexas in negotiations with GATX group.
newsitem.headline: TransTexas in negotiations with GATX group.

text.p: TransTexas Gas Corp on Thursday said it was negotiating the sale of its TransTexas Transmission Corp subsidiary to First Intercontinental Leasing Trust, a consortium of leasing and finance companies managed by GATX Capital Corp.
Although definitive agreements have not been concluded, the required governmental approvals have been received, TransTexas said.
As previously announced, the purchase price is expected to be about $1.1 billion. TransTexas Transmission is the owner of the Lobo Trend natural gas reserves, operations and related pipeline systems.

Under the multiparty sale and lease arrangement being negotiated, TransTexas Transmission would be sold the trust, which is negotiating to lease and/or sell substantially all of the assets to a major integrated oil and gas company, which has not been identified.
